subject: Logic
title: The Surprise Examination
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Surprise Examination.

hook.text: A teacher says: "There's a surprise exam next week. You won't predict which day." Can the students prove her wrong?

buildup.text: It can't be Friday—by Thursday night, students would know. Eliminate Friday. Now Thursday is last, so eliminate it too.

discovery.text: The backward elimination removes every day. Students conclude: no surprise exam is possible.

twist.text: Then Wednesday comes. Exam lands. The students are surprised. The paradox: the proof failed despite being valid?

climax.text: The issue: the students' reasoning assumes they'll still believe the teacher. Each elimination undermines the next.

punchline.text: Proving surprise impossible... was the surprise.

quiz.question: What goes wrong with the students' backward elimination?
options: Each step depends on trusting the previous one
